review.brief:
Review the DIFF of commit 57f5934 on ft/RM7-store-display-units (`git show 57f5934`). Do NOT read the whole module. This is RM7 tier 1 - purely additive. Validate, in priority order:
(1) RD12 fidelity (BLOCKER on mismatch): all four companions return plain `float64`, NOT `*float64`, and the four VehicleStateTesla.TpmsPressure{FL,FR,RL,RR} bar fields are byte-identical to before (no type change, no tag change, no removal). The adapter mirrors the API payload and converts ONLY in companions; the nil/not-reported distinction belongs one layer up in internal/telemetry and must NOT appear here.
(2) RD6 + design D3: `barToPSI = 14.503773773` is a package-level named constant in internal/tesla/types.go declared beside milesToKm, and the factor is never written inline at any call site. Grep the diff for the literal 14.503773773 outside the constant declaration and the TEST expectations - a hit in non-test code is a finding.
(3) Gold-standard conformance: the four companions mirror OdometerKm() (types.go:150) exactly - value receiver on VehicleStateTesla, one method per corner, same doc-comment style, placed immediately after OdometerKm(). No struct/array/slice return, no clever generalization.
(4) tesla-exploration stays test-free (CLAUDE.md, absolute): NO _test.go under cmd/explore-tesla-api/, no test calls any Raw* adapter method, and raw.go is untouched. Note `json.RawMessage` in vehicles_test.go:97 is pre-existing stdlib usage, not a Raw* method - not a finding.
(5) Test quality vs tasks.md 2.1/2.2: TestTpmsPressurePSICompanions uses a DISTINCT bar value per corner (so a copy-paste error reading the wrong field fails) and asserts against LITERAL expected PSI values, not against barToPSI itself. The leader rewrote these expectations from `2.9*barToPSI` to literals - see decision D4 - because a self-referential assertion pins the wiring but not the factor. Confirm the literals are arithmetically correct for 14.503773773. Also confirm the zero-bar test asserts an ordinary 0.0 PSI value (spec scenario 'A truthfully reported zero bar converts to zero PSI').
(6) Docs: internal/tesla/AGENTS.md's DTO-conventions section now covers bar->PSI alongside miles->km and names barToPSI as the module's second conversion constant. Per design D4, raw.go and cmd/explore-tesla-api/README.md correctly need NO change because no Fleet API call was added - confirm that reasoning holds against the diff. Confirm the root README.md / cmd/README.md need no change (no module added/removed, no new runnable).
(7) Anti-gaming: no task title, acceptance criterion, or assertion was weakened or deleted; tasks.md checkboxes match reality (all 15 should be ticked and genuinely satisfied).
Verification already run by the leader (do NOT re-run beyond cheap reads): go build+vet ./internal/tesla/... ok; go test ./internal/tesla/... ok including both new tests; go build ./... ok (full tree - tier 1 is additive, unlike tiers 2-4 per RD8); openspec validate --strict valid. You MAY run `go test ./internal/tesla/...` if you want to confirm, but NEVER call the live Tesla API, never run cmd/explore-tesla-api, and never run make db-* / migrate targets. Escalate on doubt: return changes-requested rather than approving anything you are unsure of.
